name: Immunology & Serology
description: Immunoglobulin classes and function, complement pathways and deficiencies, immunodeficiency patterns, and the principles of serologic and autoimmune test methods: ELISA, agglutination, syphilis algorithms, ANA patterns, heterophile testing, and viral serologic marker interpretation at the principle level.
